day_hashes_finalised_note: the file was last written while its own day was still running, so the hashes of that write described a partial day; they are re-derived from the store on a tick of a later day, and only a file that disagrees is rewritten

economics_hypothetical.note: the shadow re-reads the whole forward window on every tick, so the window totals are the hypothetical reading of the window and the *_today figures are the rows whose own timestamps fall on this date; nothing here is a realised result

latency_seconds.rule: close → store, of the bars THIS tick pulled; the window reading is in the publication

freeze.reading: the frozen corpora end at these instants; every stored bar is strictly later, and no day before the epoch is a forward observation day

observation.not_an_admission: reaching the floor makes a later decision possible; it does not make it, and this lane cannot promote a strategy
observation.not_counted: days before the observation epoch, and days whose bars arrived long after they closed, are not forward observation days: a backfill is history, not an observation
observation.rule: a day counts only if every primary asset holds at least 90% of the 24 hourly bars the calendar expects for it, and every one of those bars was stored within its timeframe's lag bound of closing ({'1h': 7200000, '15m': 1800000})
observation.window_vs_prospective: the window figure counts every stored bar after the freeze, the prospectively observed figure counts only days whose bars were stored as they closed: only the second one is an observation of the future
